summary: Blaize Holdings adopted a shareholder rights plan (poison pill) via a Rights Agreement dated April 22, 2026. The registrant declared a dividend of one Right per common share, exercisable upon a 10% triggering threshold, entitling holders to purchase 1/100th of Series A Preferred at $11.00 per Right. The board approved the plan; no advisors named. The pill runs until April 21, 2027, with a record date of May 6, 2026. This defense mechanism discourages hostile accumulation without a premium offered. Watch for activist filings or takeover attempts that might activate the Rights.
